stay.definition:
n. continuing or remaining in a place or state
n. a judicial order forbidding some action until an event occurs or the order is lifted
n. a thin strip of metal or bone that is used to stiffen a garment (e.g. a corset)
n. (nautical) brace consisting of a heavy rope or wire cable used as a support for a mast or spar
stay.translation:
n. 停留, 逗留, 制止, 延缓, 停止, 支柱, 支撑物, 支索
vt. 制止, 延缓, 坚持, 支持, 支撑, 用支索固定
vi. 停留, 逗留, 暂停, 坚持, 中止

stay bolt tap.translation: [机] 螺撑丝攻, 带铰刀丝攻

stay in.translation:
在家, 不外出
[法] 静坐

stay judgment.translation: [法] 延缓审判, 延期审判

stay loose.translation: [美国口语]保持镇静；松弛；不紧张

stay of collection.translation: [法] 延期收款, 延期征收

stay of winding up.translation: [法] 暂缓停业, 暂缓解散

stay off.translation: vt. 不要上（路）; 远离（某地）

stay put.translation: 装牢, 留在原处不动

stay up late.translation: 深夜不睡，迟睡; 熬夜

stay-at-home.definition:
n. a person who seldom goes anywhere; one not given to wandering or travel
s. not given to travel
stay-at-home.translation:
a. 不爱出门的, 不爱离乡的
n. 不爱出门的人, 不爱离乡的人

stay-at-homes.definition: n. a person who seldom goes anywhere; one not given to wandering or travel
stay-at-homes.translation: n. 不爱出门的人, 不爱离家的人( stay-at-home的复数形式 )

stay-makers.translation: (stay-maker 的复数) n. (女用)胸衣制造商

staybelite.translation: 松香的氢化物(清澈的浅黄色物质, 用作绘画、雕塑等表面的涂料, 制作增韧剂, 为纸上胶, 陶瓷印花等)
